question: Q-W-M1-D3
text: Gross margin % by selling package, FY2014 vs FY2015.
interpretation: Gross margin % by selling package (as-was stock item attribute), FY2014 vs FY2015; change in percentage points. A package with sales in only one of the two years keeps its row, with NULL for the other year.
assemble: WITH g AS (SELECT selling_package, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2014 THEN gross_margin_pct END) AS gm_2014, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2015 THEN gross_margin_pct END) AS gm_2015 FROM q WHERE lines > 0 GROUP BY selling_package) SELECT selling_package, gm_2014 AS gross_margin_pct_fy2014, gm_2015 AS gross_margin_pct_fy2015, (gm_2015 - gm_2014) * 100 AS change_points FROM g ORDER BY selling_package
